Bellows bows out, feeling he has stumbled on a top-secret aerospace project.Tony voices his nervousness to Jeannie about being spied on by Custer. When Custer disappears, Tony accuses Jeannie of turning him into nothing. Angered, Jeannie leaves. Later, when Custer comes back, having spent the day at a carnival, Tony penitently begins searching for Jeannie. He is sure Jeannie has joined a carnival act and starts a riot at the sideshow when he mistakes a veiled woman for Jeannie. Jeannie returns home and starts pulling down all the shades to outwit Custer.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E12
programme.desc: Jeannie is annoyed when Diane Rodney, a friend of Tony's, returns to town, determined to resume their old relationship. As a result, when Jeannie runs into Roger, while driving Tony's car, she accepts his invitation to dinner. Unaware that Jeannie is Roger's date, Tony instructs his friend in the fine art of courtship. Later, when Jeannie tells him she doesn't know her date's name, Tony begins to worry. When Diane arrives, Tony drags her all over town searching for Jeannie. The two couples finally meet at a nightclub. Alone with Jeannie, Tony demands she return home. Jeannie tells him she is going to listen to Roger's records.At Roger's apartment, Jeannie wards off all his attempts at romance. She leaves shortly before Tony pounds on the door looking for her. Tony points out to Roger all the mistakes he would be making if he married her. Convinced, Roger admits Tony has saved him from making a fool of himself. Jeannie is overjoyed by Tony's concern for her. Tony replies that, after all, he is only human.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E13
programme.desc: Jeannie agrees not to date Roger if Tony doesn't go out with other girls. Then Tony and Roger are assigned to escort Russian cosmonauts Major Tiomkin and Major Posnovsky during a goodwill visit. Major Tiomkin proves to be a beautiful girl named Sonya, who immediately stakes a claim on Tony. Angered, Jeannie tells Tony she is going out with Roger. Tony imprisons Jeannie in her bottle. Jeannie maneuvers the bottle into the pocket of Roger's raincoat. Roger presents the bottle to Sonya. Tony gets involved in a fracas with General Barkley and Dr. Bellows in his unsuccessful try to get the bottle back. When Sonya opens the bottle, Jeannie appears. Pointing to Sonya as her new mistress, she tells the cosmonaut she can make her every wish come true.When the plane on which Sonya is scheduled to return leaves, Tony feels her country now has possession of a decisive secret weapon. Later, dripping furs and jewelry, Sonya comes to Tony's home. She tells him Jeannie has granted her fondest desire by turning her into a wealthy American. Sonya agrees to return the bottle if Tony marries her. Tony asks a last word with Jeannie. He tells Jeannie he can't marry Sonya. Jeannie solves the problem by creating a duplicate Tony for Sonya.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E14
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Mama assures Jeannie Tony will change his mind if he thinks Jeannie is going to marry Roger. Tony asks Roger if he has met Jeannie's parents. Then Dr. Bellows announces he has bought the lot across the street. Roger asks to meet Jeannie's parents. She produces a house on Dr. Bellows' lot. Tony sees Dr. Bellows and General Hadley approaching the lot. Responding to Tony's pleas, Jeannie makes the house vanish. General Hadley and Dr. Bellows see Tony sitting in the weeds sipping tea. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. Seeing the house, he becomes distraught, and runs to Tony. As the house disappears again, they see Roger sitting in the weeds. The following day, Roger tells Tony he found himself wandering around a vacant lot. When he returned to apologize, Jeannie and the house were gone. Smiling at Jeannie, hiding in his desk drawer, Tony assures Roger he Will let him know if he ever meets Jeannie again.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E22
programme.desc: Endora, hoping to break up her daughter's marriage, superimposes Samantha's face on a print entitled "Maid of Salem:" the print is dated 1690. Darrin buys the print and then begins to worry about the difference between Samantha's age and his own. With Endora planting seeds of doubt at every turn, Darrin visualizes himself as a doddering old man, while Samantha retains her youthful appearance. Everyone, including Larry Tate and the doctor from whom Darrin seeks advice, fails to realize what is troubling him. Then, in a nearby park, Darrin overhears two squirrels to which Endora has given voice talk about their dif-ferences in age. Endora finally admits to Samantha that she can age along with Darrin. Samantha, after telling Darrin she never posed for the picture, tells him that her mother is to blame for their problem. She assures him that they will grow old together, but being in love will never note the difference. As insurance, Samantha uses witchcraft to make the "Maid of Salem" disappear.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E23
programme.desc: The lack of a traffic signal at busy Morning Glory Circle makes it virtually impossible for the Stephens or their neighbors to cross without risking life and limb. Joe Harvey calls a meeting at his home to discuss plans for doing something about it. Darrin makes an ad for a mass rally at the school auditorium to force City Hall to put a traffic light on the corner. However, Samantha has trouble getting Endora to return the traffic signals she has collected. Endora even brings a London bobby to the Stephens' living room. The bobby, of course, has disappeared by the time Gladys Kravitz brings her husband to see him. At the rally, the Mayor tells his constituents a traffic light is unnecessary. However, using her witchcraft, Samantha has the Mayor and his limousine so tied up in a traffic jam that he is convinced a traffic signal is necessary. Endora, as a final touch, brings a modern traffic signal to the Stephens home for the victory celebration. Gladys sees it, but by the time she brings Abner, Samantha makes Endora cause it to vanish.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E24
programme.desc: Samantha tells Endora she doesn't have time for a dress-fitting. Endora solves Samantha's problem by transforming herself into En-Sam, identical to Samantha. Bob Frazer, an author, falls for En-Sam and they do the town together. Meanwhile, Darrin tells Samantha to expect a visit from his friend, Bob Frazer. Gladys Kravitz, who has seen En-Sam with Bob, is sure the Stephens home is about to break up. After Bob sees Samantha and mistakes her for En-Sam, Samantha explains to Endora the trouble she is causing. Endora is convinced when she learns Bob is expected at the Stephens home. All of En-Sam's efforts to break with Bob fail. Bob is determined to have a showdown with Darrin over Samantha. Samantha tells Darrin that Bob has fallen in love with Endora. Endora, still En-Sam, arrives and Bob thinks En-Sam and Samantha are identical twins. Although Endora promises to give Bob Up, Samantha, knowing her mother, is not sure what she will do.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E25
programme.desc: Samantha and Gladys Kravitz become aware of their husbands' interest in Priscilla "Pleasure" O'Riley, a beautiful model, when she buys a house next door. Pleasure is hiding from Thor "Thunderbolt" Swenson, an offensive fullback who has threatened mayhem if he sees her with another man. Darrin becomes involved in Pleasure's affairs after he helps her move in. One night, Pleasure wakes up the Stephens. Telling them that Thunderbolt has learned her new address, she pleads for Darrin's protection. Thunderbolt arrives and Samantha inadvertently gives him the impression that Darrin is Pleasure's new boyfriend. Darrin is saved from Thunderbolt's wrath when Samantha turns him into the image of his grandmother. Then, certain that Abner is the man, Thunderbolt knocks him out and is arrested. Gladys hits the headlines when the newspapers mistakenly single her out as the object of Thunderbolt's jealousy. Pleasure's lawyer gets a court order to keep Thunderbolt away. However, Pleasure accepts Thunderbolt's offer to drive her to the Mayor's office where she is to pose as "Miss Urban Renewal."

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Extinction! Going, Going, Gone
programme.desc: Extinction, a daunting and confusing word. A force of nature, that sees the end of species, but also heralds the birth of others. Right now the extinction rate could be as much as 10,000 times faster than it should be. 20% of fish, a fifth of all reptiles and a quarter of mammals face extinction. If we are to do anything to stem the tide of extinction we must understand the lifestyles of those in danger. The future for countless animals is uncertain, but one thing is for sure – we have a lot to learn.

programme.title: Cheetah Diaries
programme.desc: There is some big-move drama as the race against time begins. The team has so much to do and not a lot of time to do it. The cubs are moving out to meet some older cheetahs, and Chobi goes in for some dental work.

programme.title: Antelope
programme.desc: For some the word ‘antelope' might not incite much interest but look closer and you'll discover a remarkably diverse group of animals, numbering nearly one hundred different species. Some are easy to miss, the little dik-dik being barely the size of a house cat, while eland weigh in at more than half a ton. There are representatives roaming plains from the Mongolian Plateau in Asia to the cape of South Africa. Wherever you find them, these remarkable animals are the unsung heroes of the plains.

programme.title: Seasons Of The Otter
programme.desc: Most of the life of an otter goes unseen following a young otter family we'll reveal the secrets of the otter's world.

programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S3 E03
programme.desc: Tanzania is known for its national parks, vast landscapes and wild roads. They make traveling a real adventure. We travel in trucks, buses and off-road vehicles from the Indian Ocean via the Serengeti to Lake Victoria, accompany huge herds of wildebeest, observe lions and rhinos - and show the lives of the people who live on and along the roads.

programme.title: Wild Sardinia
programme.desc: Sardinia has always been the epitome of pure wilderness, an emerald of volcanic origin in the Mediterranean. 1900 metres of coastline and an infinite maze of offshore islands. But Sardinia also has other facets: green valleys, rugged mountains, murmuring brooks, mysterious ruins and a unique fauna. Just off of Sardinia's coast is an untouched underwater paradise - uniquely beautiful, but also dangerous. Pilot whales, dolphins and mobula rays populate the waters at Capo Testa in the north of the island. In the west, the lagoons of Cabras represent a wild landscape of lakes in which thousands of flamingos live and hunt the red brine shrimps. In addition to the flamingos, grey and purple herons and little egrets breed here. Thousands of bats have found refuge in the craggy mountain world of the Supramonte and Gennargentu, with their countless grottoes and caves. In the sea we can observe the mass mating of sea slugs, and thanks to our camera robots and submersible boats we were able to observe beard worms with luminous red gills, as well as bright yellow tree corals in the area surrounding the hypothermal lava holes.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: "Cleaning woman island", concrete castles, Ballermann: Mallorca's image is negatively affected in some respects. The documentary explores the charm of the largest Balearic island beyond the hustle and bustle of tourism and Rambazamba. The "real" Mallorca is best explored through real Majorcans: Manolo Barahona, TV fishing expert from the local island broadcaster IB3, faces the most difficult task of the year. The Raor is in season, the most expensive fish on the island. Manolo is supposed to get him first in front of the camera and then in the pan. There's only one catch, the little fish with the piranha teeth just doesn't want to be on TV. In the first months of the year Mallorca turns into a sea of almond blossoms. There are around seven million almond trees on the island, once planted to replace dead vines. But now also the almond trees are threatened. The fire bacterium continues to spread, especially on the large plantations. The farmer Biel Torrens wants to save Mallorca's almond trees and fruit with a small organic plantation and gentle harvesting methods. He shakes the almonds from the tree by hand instead of using a mechanical vibrator.

programme.title: Secrets of the Mediterranean
programme.desc: The contours of the Mediterranean have changed during the course of its history. Near Gibraltar, Africa was once connected to the European continent. When the land bridge at Gibraltar collapsed, the Mediterranean basin filled up again. The Suez Canal is today connected to the Red Sea. This route enables animals to reach the Mediterranean, where they cause problems.

programme.title: Secrets of the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Rugged rocks, blue sea and idyllic, sandy beaches - this is the Mediterranean as we know it. But this impression is deceptive: the Mediterranean is under constant change. The continents are moving towards one another. Animals, that have to survive under such extreme conditions, must find a way to escape the dangers. Between deserts and volcanoes, the challenges for the animals are enormous.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: The Inner Hebrides surprise with green hills, fine sandy beaches and a mild climate, at least as far as Scottish conditions allow. This is ensured by the currents of the Gulf Stream, as well as the Scottish archipelago being protected by its sister islands, which belong to the Outer Hebrides. More than half of the almost 80 islands are uninhabited. Loneliness has made the people rather inventive. On Tiree Island, mathematics, history and physics from the mainland arrive in the classroom per mouseclick. Dr Mauvis Gore and Prof. Rupert Ormond cast off from the island of Mull, after setting a course to encounter a basking shark. The cetohinus maximus is the world's second largest fish and the two scientists are absolutely convinced that the waters surrounding the Mull constitute the mating grounds for the basking sharks. A logistical challenge takes place on the Isle of Easdale each September. Then, around 400 people populate the tiny slate island. Donals "Mellon" Melville organises the World Skimming Championships, a World Cup in jumping stones. This is all about the distance they are thrown and they must only hop above the water twice.

programme.title: Countries People Adventures
programme.desc: In southeastern Iceland, Europe's largest glacier, the gigantic Vatnajökull, covers an area of around 9,000 square kilometers. Beneath it lie the world's most active and dangerous volcanoes. This extreme landscape is as dangerous as it is fascinating: glistening white glacier tongues, lagoons covered with icebergs, bizarre green lava mountains, snow-covered volcanic cones, solidified lava flows and imposing waterfalls overwhelm everyone who gets to see them. In 2008, Icelanders declared the glacier and adjacent areas a national park, the largest in Europe. In this documentary, the team meets people who live, work or do research here: a life with the dangers of fire and ice in the overwhelming landscape of Vatnajökull National Park.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: Idlewild - Avalon - Belle of Louisville - these three names stand for the last still roadworthy, historic sternwheeler in the USA. In 1914, the ship was built as "Idlewild" for the West Memphis Packet Company as a passenger ferry. With a draft of only 1.50 m and a robust steel hull, the boat is suitable for almost all navigable rivers of the Mississippi River system. Today, the "Belle" is the most traveled steamboat in American history. In the course of her eventful life, she has called at 130 places in 19 states.

programme.title: The Hebrides: Land of Legends
programme.desc: Lying just off the coast of west Scotland, the Hebrides archipelago is made up of more than 500 islands and islets. Isolation from the mainland has made it the perfect breeding ground for millions of creatures. / Japan's 7,000 islands stretch for over 2,400 km, and cover an incredible range of climates. programme.title: From Sardinia to Abruzzo
programme.desc: For many people, Sardinia is THE Mediterranean dream island: clichés like crystal-clear water and picturesque coastlines are reality here. Wild horses inhabit the vast unpopulated plateaux of Gesturi. In the adjacent high regions lies the kingdom of the imposing Mouflon. The curved horns of the male come in handy when battling over the females during rutting season. A breathtaking underwater world is hidden beneath the crystal clear water surrounding the island. Colourful fish, corals and sea snails live down here - as well as the basking shark! He can grow up to ten metres long, but he's completely harmless: with his huge mouth he only fishes microorganisms from the water. Sicily, off the coast at the tip of Italy's ‘boot', is the largest island in the Mediterranean. The island's most famous landmark is already visible from far-off: Etna, at 3340 metres the highest active volcano in Europe. Only 40 kilometres away another volcano looms high: Stromboli, which lies in the middle of the sea. It spews lava and fire at virtually minute intervals. From ancient times on, humans have feared the volcanoes of south Italy. Even today, there are 2500 year-old temple grounds still standing on Sicily. These days nature is re-claiming the age-old buildings – Mason bees and lizards inhabit the cracks and crevices, while lush flower meadows surround the ancient pillars. Abruzzo, lying level with Rome, is the wild heart of southern Italy. The rugged, uninhabited mountain world with its unspoilt beech forests make Abruzzo something special: this is Italy from its unfamiliar side! The inaccessible slopes are the territory of the extremely rare Apennine chamois. During rutting, the bucks engage in breakneck chases among the rocks.

programme.title: Islands of Monsoon

programme.title: Wild Serbia
programme.desc: Serbia is in the heart of the Balkans, a “little Europe“ within Europe with its rich variety of landscapes and natural beauties, it certainly does this name justice. This nature documentary presents Serbia's breath-taking, picturesque regions and unique wildlife on a journey to the most beautiful and wildest areas of the Balkan peninsula, from high mountains across gentle hills to the vast plains of the Puszta. Serbia is only about five times the size of Schleswig Holstein, yet here the most varied vegetation zones, animal kingdoms and cultures meet. And even today a large number of Serbian people live in close communion with nature. They are proud of the storks' nests in the villages, the ancient species of livestock that have been preserved and the vultures that return to make their home here. In many places people are pleased to see bears, lynx and wolves, and even jackals are at home in the forests of Siberia. It is a country full of traditions and folklore, with deep influences from the Orient as well as the West. The Danube is the most prominent river in Serbia. As it makes its way through the Carpathian Mountains of Rumania it forms the most imposing gorge in Europe, the Iron Gates. Other striking features of Serbia's landscape include the archaic earth pyramids of Devil's Town, towering up in powerful red colours - and what must be the driest region of Siberia, the Deliblatska Pescara, which is also known as Europe's Sahara. Colourful birds called bee-eaters have settled on a rocky slope - a whole, noisy colony of them. They make their nests in caves which they dig themselves in the ground, and the inaccessible location means it is difficult for enemies to reach them. The more frequently the male brings the female insects it has caught, the more powerful is the bond between them later.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing they must defend the Kingdom from Jestro's monsters, the Knights try to organize but are despondent when they discover their best advisor – Merlok the Magician – has sacrificed himself to save them. When Jestro awakens, he's been blasted miles and miles away from the King's Castle by Merlok's explosive spell. And, it seems, all the books he was trying to steal have been scattered, too. The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. Meanwhile, the King and his newly-trained Knights pick through the rubble of Merlok's library. They'll have to figure something out, because Jestro and his newly made magic monsters attack King's Castle! Clay organizes the Knights to defend the kingdom, but they've never worked together before. It takes all their training, plus the help of an old friend…MERLOK! Only now he's MERLOK 2.0. Ava has been piecing together what happened and discovering that the “ghost in the machine” she's been chasing is really Merlok in digital form. Now, he can use his magic digitally and he downloads just the right weapons to the struggling Knights! They finally foil Jestro's attack with Merlok's help and officially become NEXO KNIGHTS!

programme.title: The Power Of Merlok
programme.desc: When Jestro attacks a village on the far side of the Kingdom, the NEXO-Knights wonder how they'll get there. Then Macy remembers her dad has a royal RV…maybe they can “mod” that for their own, “knightly” use? Now the NEXO-Knights get rolling…in THE FORTREX, their own ROLLING CASTLE! This great new HQ, which houses Merlok 2.0 as an operating system, will be how the knights move around Knighton and protect it from Jestro and his monsters. Speaking of the evil jester, in this episode Jestro uses some newly-made monsters to attack a town far from the capitol where he thinks he's safe from the Knights' reach. We see two parallel stories here: the Knights training, learning more about digital magic and getting organized as a team and at the same time we see Jestro making monsters, trying to learn how his powers work and talking to the Book. In the end, the Knights roll up in their castle and defeat Jestro and his marauding monsters. Lance thinks he should be the leader because he's a snot. “Of course I'm the leader…I'm a Richmond.”

programme.title: The Knights Code
programme.desc: Jestro uses the Book of Chaos to unleash, um, chaos and attack the King's hover train to try and kidnap the royal party. Can the NEXO-Knights bring order out of the chaos and save the King? Jestro finds the Book of Chaos in the countryside and decides he must feed it to the book. The Book of Monsters actually tells Jestro NOT to feed it to him he tells Jestro he's not ready for that kind of power. But Jestro doesn't listen. Now the Book unleashes chaotic monsters and Jestro uses them to attack the King and his party who are on a business-related tour of the kingdom. When the NEXO-Knights show up to stop the monster attacks and realize that they must save King and Queen Halbert – Macy's parents – from the chaotic evil monsters that have been unleashed. Clay asserts himself as leader and brings order to the knights from the chaos. He has his own book: the Book of the Knight's Code. They should all live by it.

He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

The girls quickly unite, helping each-other to save the day and most importantly have fun along the way!

Kidnapped along with her daughter Christy, it's a tense game of hunt - or be hunted - against a ruthless gang of degenerates and their violently unhinged matriarch, Becky. Hailed as a feminist revenge masterpiece by some, and misunderstood as crude exploitation by others, revenge is about to come full circle in Deja Vu, the final chapter in cinema's most shocking cult franchise.

They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Maata Ki Mahima
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Hamare
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: Stories By Rabindranath Tagore
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: Do Chutki Sindoor
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. programme.title: Ground Report

programme.title: Ground Report

programme.title: Ground Report
programme.desc: From October 15, 2026, UPI transactions above ₹2,000 will attract a Merchant Discount Rate (MDR), with select sectors like railways, fuel, telecom, insurance and utility payments paying a flat ₹5 charge. Consumers, however, will continue to use UPI without paying any transaction fee.

programme.title: Ground Report
programme.desc: The Lallantop visited a Primary Health Centre in Songudda village, Balaghat, where doctors are treating tribal children with limited facilities—sometimes on wooden planks, tables and floors. The report captures the challenges of healthcare access in remote tribal regions.

programme.title: Ground Report
programme.desc: The Lallantop visited a government primary school in Balaghat to understand the everyday reality of education for tribal children. programme.title: Ground Report
programme.desc: In Balaghat's Baiga tribal villages, families who once relied on traditional healers are now turning to doctors and hospitals after a series of child illnesses and deaths. The Lallantop travelled to these remote habitations to understand this quiet shift.

programme.title: Ground Report
programme.desc: Lallantop spoke to DU students on voting day to find out what shaped their vote in DUSU 2026. Was the Satya Niketan tragedy a major issue, or were fees, hostels, and campus safety bigger concerns?

programme.title: LIVE GURBANI KIRTAN FROM AMRITSAR
programme.desc: Live Gurbani Kirtan from Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib on GTC Punjabi Television brings viewers a sacred spiritual experience directly from one of the most revered historical Gurudwaras of Sikhism, located in the heart of Delhi. This live telecast offers devotees the divine resonance of Gurbani Kirtan, performed by esteemed Ragis, filling homes with peace, devotion, and spiritual reflection. Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib stands as a powerful symbol of supreme sacrifice and unwavering faith, marking the martyrdom of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji, who laid down his life for the protection of religious freedom and human rights. Through this live broadcast, GTC Punjabi Television connects Sangat across the globe to the serene atmosphere of the Gurudwara, allowing viewers to immerse themselves in Naam Simran, Shabad Kirtan, and the timeless wisdom of Gurbani. The soulful renditions inspire inner calm, strengthen spiritual connection, and spread the universal message of love, equality, and humility as taught by the Sikh Gurus.

programme.title: Gurmat Vichar
programme.desc: Katha by Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji on GTC Punjabi Television presents a profound spiritual discourse rooted in the timeless wisdom of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Renowned for his deep knowledge, powerful narration, and simple yet impactful explanations, Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji brings Gurbani to life by connecting its teachings with everyday human experiences. Through soulful storytelling, historical references, and meaningful interpretations of Gurbani, this Katha guides the Sangat towards self-reflection, humility, and spiritual awakening. Each session offers clarity on life's challenges while emphasizing the values of Naam Simran, Seva, truthful living, and unwavering faith in Waheguru.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.4
programme.desc: As department heads at Sejung Hospital clamor to have Sunwoo admitted to their own units, the residents are left confused and overwhelmed. A new notice is issued declaring that all surgical cases must be handled by the on-call surgeon, and Euna watches with concern as Inhyuk exits the operating room.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.5
programme.desc: After Inhyuk completes the surgery, both sides scramble to prepare for an impending disciplinary hearing—the ER staff on one side, and the department heads on the other, each holding urgent strategy meetings. Meanwhile, when the guardian of a patient complaining of abdominal pain aggressively demands discharge, Minwoo allows the patient to leave.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.6
programme.desc: When the surgery schedule for a high school girl injured in a traffic accident falls into chaos, everyone can't help but miss Choi Inhyuk's presence, while Minwoo sinks into self-doubt. Meanwhile, a clue surfaces about the whereabouts of a patient discharged with suspected bowel perforation, and Jaein stands her ground without hesitation—even in the face of threats from gangsters.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.7
programme.desc: Thanks to Jaein and Minwoo, Jiyoung undergoes surgery successfully and later posts a heartfelt message of gratitude on the hospital website, earning Minwoo recognition as a “Kindness Award” staff member. Meanwhile, Inhyuk, who has submitted his resignation and begun searching for a new job, witnesses another traffic accident unfold right before his eyes.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.8
programme.desc: When Sunwoo, currently hospitalized in the ICU, is scheduled for surgery, Minwoo struggles with how to break the news to Jaein. At the same time, a reporter named Kyungho arrives at the ER to investigate, publishing an article about Hansoo, who is hospitalized there—instantly thrusting the hospital into the media spotlight.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.9
programme.desc: A middle-aged man feigns illness and behaves inappropriately toward Jaein, leaving her deeply uncomfortable, but Minwoo steps in to defuse the situation and comfort her. Elsewhere, Minjun confidently enters the operating room, only to find that Wonguk's condition is far more critical than expected—leaving him powerless to intervene.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Meaningful Stone! Since releasing her debut single Camera in My Dreams in July 2017 she has garnered much attention with her self-produced music videos and live performance videos on YouTube. Naturally she became one of the most aspiring indie musicians in the Korean music scene who was also highly praised by renowned music critic and writer Bae Soon-tak. This past September Meaningful Stone released her first full-length album a call from my dreams which is named after the lead single off the album. As the title implies the song is about a call she received in her dreams when she was struggling with life's ups and downs. As opposed to reality she was continuously speaking words of love to herself while dreaming. She shares that hopeful message with listeners to offer a moment of comfort. In this episode Meaningful Stone performs a call from my dream nameless treasure hunt if I grow up as if and beep-boop-beep-boop. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and check out her unpredictable yet genuine musicality!

programme.title: Indipedia
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: Umeed India
programme.desc: If you'd imagine an ace cricketer to host a television show, you can be sure it will be a sports related series. And, Umeed India makes a compelling case. For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. Watch Virender travel to their training bases, chronicling exciting moments in the home environment besides interviewing the athletes' families and coaching staff. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.title: Tyohaar Ki Thaali
programme.desc: Sakshi Tanwar in Tyohaar Ki Thaali decides to celebrate one festival a week and along with the celebration, she also prepares two dishes from her mom's diary which is her prized possession. Along with preparing the dishes she also reminisces into the moments of how she celebrated some festivals and also shares some stories about the Gods.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. Watch Virender travel to their training bases, chronicling exciting moments in the home environment besides interviewing the athletes' families and coaching staff. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

First up, entertaining host Spencer fires tosses clams in velvety butter, zesty garlic and earthy spices to make his Clams with Garlic Paprika Butter. Next up is a traditional Indian recipe, but done on the grill - Butter Chicken! All the butter chicken flavours we love are infused in the marinade, before getting crisped up on the fiery grill - the result is both classic and completely new! Scallops are next, grilled and served with a mouth-watering caper-raisin butter. For his final recipe Chef Watts prepares a rich and juicy grilled Rib Steak topped with a decadent port wine compound butter. Oh, what a butter-loving day!

programme.desc: Una storia sui giovani della classe borghese italiana degli anni Sessanta e sui loro modi di impiegare il tempo.

programme.title: Detenuto in attesa di giudizio
programme.desc: Giuseppe è un geometra emigrato in Svezia, dove ha fatto fortuna con la sua piccola impresa edile. Torna in Italia per far conoscere il suo Paese alla moglie Ingrid, ma alla frontiera viene inspiegabilmente fermato e quindi arrestato. In carcere, scopre di essere accusato di un delitto gravissimo. Una delle rare interpretazioni drammatiche del magistrale Alberto Sordi.

programme.title: Le Ragazze di Piazza di Spagna
programme.desc: Maria, Elena e Lucia sono tre amiche che lavorano in una sartoria vicino a Piazza di Spagna. Tutte hanno qualche problema con i rispettivi fidanzati: uno è troppo geloso, un altro non è sincero, un altro ancora è troppo assente. Attraversando mille avventure, le ragazze proveranno a realizzare il loro sogno d'amore.

programme.title: Il brigadiere Pasquale Zagaria ama la mamma e la polizia
programme.desc: Primo film da protagonista di Lino Banfi. Degradato e infine espulso dalla polizia per inettitudine comprovata, il brigadiere pugliese Pasquale Zagaria si ritira a vita privata nella campagna romana. Ma ben presto resta coinvolto in un oscuro traffico di diamanti. Con l'aiuto della vigorosa moglie Pupetta, cintura nera di karate, Zagaria torna ad affrontare i delinquenti.

programme.title: Totòtruffa '62
programme.desc: Il principe della risata Totò in un'esilarante commedia. Antonio e Felice sono due simpatiche canaglie che, grazie alla capacità di travestirsi, tirano avanti con furti e piccoli raggiri. Il tutto per mantenere Diana, figlia di Antonio, in un lussuoso collegio. Sulle loro tracce, intanto si fa avanti il commissario Malvasia, ex compagno di scuola di Antonio.

programme.title: Casanova 70
programme.desc: Andrea, ufficiale della Nato, è colpito da un`ossessione che lo spinge a compiere azioni rischiose per le sue conquiste galanti. Lo psicanalista, ascoltato il racconto delle sue avventure, gli rimprovera l`eccessiva frenesia amorosa e gli consiglia una vacanza di riposo in montagna. Ma anche in vacanza Andrea non perde il vizio di correre dietro alle donne...

programme.title: L'ingorgo
programme.desc: Un corteo di macchine procede sempre più lentamente lungo la tangenziale di Roma, sino a che ogni possibilità di movimento si blocca. L`ingorgo durerà 36 ore. Sin dai primi momenti il nervosismo dei viaggiatori è evidente. Quando sfumano le speranze di una veloce soluzione, mancano notizie, si palesano le prime necessità, la tensione sale al massimo e non pochi trascendono. La circostanza permette di scoprire i lati peggiori dell`umanità presente...

programme.title: La grande abbuffata
programme.desc: In una villa fuori Parigi quattro vecchi amici si riuniscono per un week-end abbandonandosi ad un`orgia di cibo e sesso. Uno di loro, Marcello, porta con sé alcune prostitute che disgustate dall`ambiente se ne andranno. Ad un certo punto una maestra va lì per caso con in suoi alunni in visita al giardino della villa, rimane affascinata dai quattro e decide di fare ritorno unendosi a loro nel folle e autodistruttivo fine settimana...

programme.title: L'orchestra rossa
programme.desc: L`orchestra rossa è la più importante rete di spie della seconda guerra mondiale. Si tratta di una storia incredibile ma assolutamente vera, che ricostruisce come un manipolo di audaci non professionisti di diverse nazionalità, senza alcuna esperienza sul campo, sia riuscito a tenere in scacco i nazisti sottraendo informazioni segretissime persino durante le riunioni di Hitler con i suoi generali

programme.title: Il segreto di una famiglia
programme.desc: Eugenia torna a La Quietud, la tenuta di famiglia vicino a Buenos Aires, dopo un ictus che ha colpito suo padre. Si ritrova con sua madre e sorella, costrette a confrontarsi con traumi emotivi e segreti legati al passato durante la dittatura militare, dove le vecchie gelosie riaffiorano.

programme.title: A Kid Like Jake
programme.desc: Alex Wheeler e suo marito Greg stanno cercando di trovare la scuola elementare giusta per il loro figlio di 4 anni, Jake. Descritto come gender-expansive dal suo consulente, il comportamento sempre più irregolare di Jake inizia a causare una spaccatura tra la coppia. Alex teme che gli adulti della sua vita lo stiano etichettando prematuramente, mentre Greg si chiede se la passione di Jake per i travestimenti non sia solo una fase.

programme.title: And then I go
programme.desc: Edwin e Flake frequentano le scuole medie e soffrono di uno stato di ansia. Incompresi dalle loro famiglie e demoralizzati a scuola ogni giorno, la loro furia cova finché un'idea di vendetta non offre loro una terrificante liberazione.

programme.title: Fin qui tutto bene?
programme.desc: A fine febbraio 2020, anche in Italia arriva l'epidemia di COVID-19, causando contagi e decessi. Mentre la quarantena confina chiunque in casa, una famiglia è colpita da un dramma terribile: un ragazzo di vent'anni vede la madre suicidarsi.

programme.title: Omicidio!
programme.desc: Un'affascinante donna, aspirante attrice, viene accusata di omicidio. Uno dei giurati incaricati di deliberare sul suo caso crede nella sua innocenza e inizia ad investigare per identificare il vero assassino.

programme.title: UN ANNO PER CAMBIARE
programme.desc: Dopo esser caduto da un tetto alla festa di Capodanno ed essere sopravvissuto, Owen decide che è il momento di cambiare vita. Obiettivi principali: innamorarsi e rientrare in contatto col figlio

programme.title: LA DOPPIA VITA DI MIO MARITO
programme.desc: Una donna scopre che il marito nasconde una vita parallela e decide di indagare, ritrovandosi coinvolta in una spirale di bugie e pericolo.

programme.title: INGANNO IN PARADISO
programme.desc: Una vacanza da sogno si trasforma in un incubo quando emergono inganni e intenzioni nascoste.

programme.title: 10 cose di noi
programme.desc: Un attore si deve preparare per un ruolo quando incontra una commessa del supermercato: un incontro che cambierà entrambe le loro vite

programme.title: THE ROMANTICS
programme.desc: Sette trentenni, compagni al college, si riuniscono dopo 6 anni per il matrimonio di Tom e Lila. La notte prima del matrimonio, Laura, damigella d'onore di Lila ed ex fiamma di Tom, e il promesso sposo scoprono di essere ancora innamorati.

programme.title: LAssassinio Di Un Allibratore Cinese
programme.desc: Cosmo Vittelli, titolare di uno squallido cabaret, perde una enorme cifra al gioco, indebitandosi con il criminale Mort. Quest'ultimo gli offre la possibilità di ripagare il proprio debito eliminando un fastidioso allibratore protetto dalla mafia.

programme.title: Finché giudice non ci separi
programme.desc: Massimo, Paolo, Roberto e Mauro sono quattro amici, tutti separati e accomunati dal rancore verso il giudice che ha seguito le loro separazioni. Situazioni paradossali e sorprese sempre dietro l'angolo, in una commedia divertentissima.

programme.title: Shaolin Basket
programme.desc: Shi-Jie viene trovato da bambino nella spazzatura e cresciuto in un'accademia di arti marziali. Arrivato all'università, entra nella squadra di basket e insegna il Kung Fu ai suoi compagni per far colpo sulla sorella del capitano della squadra!

programme.title: Guerra al virus
programme.desc: America anni '80. Il dottor Francis è uno dei primi a scoprire il virus dell'Hiv, ma la società americana rimane indifferente alla malattia considerandola pericolosa solo per gli omosessuali.

programme.title: 11 Settembre
programme.desc: Un gruppo di 5 persone si trova intrappolato in un ascensore nella Torre Nord del World Trade Center l'undici settembre. Senza mai abbandonare la speranza, cerca di liberarsi e fuggire prima che accada l'impensabile.

programme.title: Shrapnel
programme.desc: Un ex marine (Jason Patric) e il suo vecchio compagno di guerra (Cam Gigandet) si infiltrano nel pericoloso mondo di un cartello messicano per scoprire la verità sulla scomparsa della figlia. Riusciranno a sopravvivere e a fare giustizia?

programme.title: Undisputed 4: Il ritorno di Boyka
programme.desc: Yuri Boyka sta portando in alto il suo nome nel mondo dei grandi campionati di combattimento quando una morte accidentale sul ring lo costringe a mettere in discussione tutto ciò che egli rappresenta.

programme.title: La mia super ex-ragazza
programme.desc: “La mia super ex-ragazza” segue le vicissitudini di Matt Saunders (Luke Wilson), un uomo ordinario, che lascia la sua storica fidanzata (Uma Thurman) – e scopre molto presto che è una supereroina ora in cerca di vendetta.

programme.title: Becoming Jane
programme.sub-title: Il ritratto di una donna contro
programme.desc: Jane Austen è una ventenne romantica e indipendente nell'Inghilterra del 1795. Jane sogna un matrimonio d'amore mentre sua madre è ansiosa di accasarla con un aristocratico facoltoso. L'arrivo di Tom Lefroy, affascinante ma privo di mezzi, sconvolgerà gli equilibri della piccola comunità locale.

programme.title: 47 Metri
programme.desc: Un'immersione tra le rovine di una città sommersa si trasforma in un incubo. Quattro amiche sono intrappolate sott'acqua, circondate da squali letali e cunicoli che sembrano stringersi attorno a loro. Sopravvivere richiede sangue freddo… e pura fortuna.

programme.title: 47 Metri
programme.desc: Dopo un incidente aereo, cinque amici si ritrovano su una zattera in mezzo al mare, senza cibo né aiuto in vista. Gli squali affamati pattugliano ogni loro mossa, trasformando il mare in una trappola mortale. Sopravvivere sembra impossibile, ma arrendersi non è un'opzione.

programme.title: Hard night falling
programme.desc: Durante una cena nella lussuosa villa della famiglia Rossini, il criminale Goro e la sua banda prendono in ostaggio gli invitati per rubare un'ingente quantità d'oro. Ignorano però che tra gli ospiti c'è Michael Anderson (Dolph Lundgren), un agente dell'Interpol altamente addestrato, determinato a salvare la sua famiglia e sventare il colpo.

programme.title: Il silenzio del testimone
programme.desc: Un importante avvocato difensore torna nella sua piccola città natale per difendere un vecchio amico accusato di omicidio.

programme.title: L'amore fa male
programme.desc: Germana ha una figlia e un sogno mai infranto di essere attrice. Amante di un ricco avvocato, incontra Gianmarco in una corsia d'ospedale e se ne innamora perdutamente. Corrisposta con altrettanta passione da Gianmarco, ignora che l'uomo sia padre, marito e amico di vecchia data di Elisabetta, una rigida vicina di casa. Davanti a una tavola imbandita s'incroceranno e risolveranno i loro destini.

programme.title: La ricerca del vero amore
programme.desc: Becks, una giornalista romantica decide di aiutare il suo migliore amico Casey alla ricerca del suo primo amore. In questo viaggio, entrambi scoprono di più l'uno dell'altro e Becks deve affrontare un dilemma: aiutare Casey o rischiare di aprirle il cuore.

programme.title: Il ragazzo dei miei sogni
programme.desc: Abby, orientata alla carriera, accetta di aiutare il suo capo impegnato a trovare l'uomo dei suoi sogni, ma incontra un dilemma quando inizia a innamorarsi dello stesso uomo con cui il suo capo approva gli appuntamenti.

programme.title: Un autunno molto speciale
programme.desc: Gli amici d'infanzia Frankie e Nate si ritrovano a dover dividere un bellissimo vigneto del quale entrambi risultano proprietari e a sfidarsi per poter vincere una competizione autunnale nella quale si eleggerà il miglior vino della regione. La loro rivalità però lascerà ben presto spazio a sentimenti molto più romantici.

programme.title: I consigli di zia Hope
programme.desc: Audrey si reca a Hope Cove per scrivere su una rubrica anonima di consigli d'amore. Lì incontra il caporedattore Morgan Cooper. Tra i due scocca subito la scintilla. Sarà proprio Audrey ad essere la nuova protagonista di una delle storie d'amore di cui scrive?

programme.title: La favola di Emma
programme.desc: Emma ha creato un sito dedicato al lifestyle chiamato Classically Emma, mettendoci tutta la sua passione. Ma quando le sue statistiche iniziano a calare, considera di unirsi alla determinata Jill come soluzione.

programme.title: Dance off: sfida a ritmo di danza
programme.desc: Due squadre di danza rivali della stessa città si affrontano per il Campionato Nazionale.

programme.title: Il progetto del cuore
programme.desc: La timida artista Isla resta sconvolta quando il suo dipinto viene venduto per errore al carismatico venditore Mark, il cui capo vuole commissionarle una scultura. Con l'incoraggiamento di Mark, la fiducia di Isla cresce… e anche il loro amore.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: Quando Joel (Paul Rudd) e Molly (Amy Poehler) si incontrano, è odio a prima vista: la grande azienda produttrice di dolciumi di lui minaccia di far chiudere la piccola impresa indipendente di lei.

programme.title: Una moglie ideale
programme.desc: In questo sguardo oltraggiosamente divertente al matrimonio e alla sessualità negli anni '90, un uomo felicemente sposato convince la sua amorevole moglie ad aiutarlo a vivere la fantasia maschile definitiva.

programme.title: Ti amo presidente
programme.desc: Due colleghi decidono di incontrarsi fuori dal prestigioso studio legale in cui lavorano. Lei, Michelle, è il supervisore di lui, l'affascinate Barack. L'incontro ha tutta l'aria di essere un primo appuntamento nonostante la reticenza di Michelle. Da quel giorno il mondo non è stato più lo stesso.

programme.title: La programmazione riprenderà a breve
programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Delitto d'amore
programme.desc: Un dramma sociale diretto da Luigi Comencini ed interpretato da Stefania Sandrelli e Giuliano Gemma. Nullo e Carmela lavorano nella stessa fabbrica e s'innamorano ma, dopo che lei si ammala per alcune esalazioni tossiche, lui cerca vendetta.

programme.title: Here After
programme.desc: Uno sguardo oscuro sul significato dell'amore nell'aldilà.

programme.title: On the Inside
programme.desc: Un giovane onesto ma problematico viene mandato in un istituto psichiatrico per pazzi criminali e presto si ritrova in una lotta per la vita combattendo contro fantasmi nella sua testa e nemici molto reali intorno a lui.

programme.title: Il sesso e Mrs. X (Sex & Mrs. X)
programme.desc: È buffo cosa pochi giorni a Parigi possono insegnare a una donna single da poco sulla vita e sull'amore. Ma la cosa più buffa è che lo imparerà da una donna che dirige un servizio di escort d'alto bordo.

programme.title: Un padre in prestito
programme.desc: Per poter adottare un ragazzo problematico, un impiegato postale solitario e non sposato deve dimostrare di essere emotivamente qualificato per amare e accudire un bambino.

programme.title: City of Lies
programme.desc: Russell Poole è un ex-detective che ha immolato la sua vita e la sua carriera alle indagini su un caso che non è mai riuscito a risolvere, quello degli omicidi delle due star del rap Tupac Shakur e The Notorious B.I.G.

programme.title: Turbolenze damore
programme.desc: Durante un volo da New York a Parigi, Antoine si ritrova seduto proprio accanto alla propria ex ragazza con la quale ha avuto una brutta rottura tre anni prima. I due rivivono così gli alti e bassi della relazione che hanno avuto.

programme.title: Una corona per due
programme.desc: Quando il fidanzato di Riley, Mandla, la invita in Sudafrica per conoscere la sua famiglia, lei rimane scioccata nello scoprire che lui è un principe. La notizia mette in pericolo la fiducia di Riley in Mandla.

programme.title: Come ti organizzo il Natale
programme.desc: Conosciuto come un "risollevatore" per clienti difficili, un talentuoso organizzatore di feste deve aiutare un giovane amministratore delegato a organizzare la festa di Natale dell'anno per stupire il sindaco e salvare la sua azienda. Il "fixer" risolverà qualcosa di più della semplice azienda?

programme.title: Scambio di identità
programme.desc: Connie, nubile ed incinta, viaggia in direzione di Boston in treno ed incontra una giovane e facoltosa coppia di sposini in luna di miele, Hugh e Patricia. Durante il tragitto, il convoglio subisce un incidente grave e la ragazza finisce in ospedale.

programme.title: Il fiume delle verità
programme.desc: Un giovane abbandona la famiglia per una vita solitaria di pesca a mosca. Il suo obiettivo era trovare la propria strada nel mondo della pesca e quindi ritrovare se stesso e l'amore.

programme.title: La Finestra di Alice
programme.desc: Gabriele, aspirante scrittore pieno di debiti, passa le giornate a spiare dalla finestra la bella dirimpettaia Alice. Non riuscendo a sostenere le spese per il lussuoso appartamento avuto in eredità, il giovane decide di affittare una stanza allo spagnolo Fabio. La convivenza fra i due si rivela piuttosto complicata perché i ragazzi si scontrano spesso per via di grosse diversità caratteriali, ma poco dopo nel palazzo di Alice avviene un omicidio e Fabio diviene il principale indiziato.

programme.title: I Corti di WeShort
programme.desc: The Last Architect: Nell'anno 2446, la Terra è completamente ricoperta di edifici. Nova, l'ultimo architetto, non ha più un lavoro, ma vince un concorso che le cambierà la vita. A Date with Mr Mappleton: Una cena romantica si trasforma in un incubo quando i souvenir preziosi della casa, gelosi della proprietaria, iniziano ad attaccare l'invitato. Tentatrice: Myrtille è disperatamente attratta dal cantante del cabaret. Una notte, il potere di un profumo particolare le dà la possibilità di uscire dall'ombra... 100.000 Acres of Pine: La ranger Megan Patel deve scoprire il mistero della morte del fratello. Ma seguendo le sue tracce, Megan scopre un'oscurità alla quale potrebbe non essere in grado di sfuggire. Haircut: Un'insegnante e il suo studente si trattengono in un'aula vuota. Attraverso sguardi e gesti, inizia uno strano confronto. Juliet: In un futuro non troppo lontano, la società SEED lancia con successo sul mercato Juliet, un androide da compagnia di prima generazione. La tecnologia continua così la sua avanzata e modelli sempre nuovi arrivano nei negozi ma allo stesso l'umanità ha sempre più difficoltà a trovare il proprio spazio..

programme.title: Party Girl
programme.desc: Angélique ha 60 anni. Ama ancora le feste, le piacciono ancora gli uomini. Di notte, per guadagnarsi da vivere, gli fa bere in un night club nei pressi del confine con la Germania. Con il passare del tempo, i clienti diventano sempre piu' rari. Ma Michel, suo cliente fisso, è ancora innamorato di lei. Un giorno, chiede a Angélique di sposarlo.

programme.title: Sugar!
programme.desc: Leslie una casalinga e insegnante di pianoforte di oltre 50 anni decide di seguire il sogno della sua vita di essere una cantante rock 'n roll. Purtroppo questa sua decisione viene accolta con grande disappunto da parte del marito che che è in corsa per una carica politica.

programme.title: Un affare di famiglia
programme.desc: Dopo una delle loro sessioni di taccheggio, Osamu e il figlio si imbattono in una bambina lasciata al freddo. Seppur dapprima riluttante, la moglie di Osamu accetta di prendersene cura dopo avere appreso le difficoltà che la piccola deve affrontare. Sebbene la famiglia sia povera e guadagni solo lo stretto necessario per sopravvivere, tutti sono felici finché un incidente imprevisto porta alla luce segreti tenuti ben nascosti, mettendo alla prova ogni legame.

programme.title: Jellyfish
programme.desc: Tra il bullismo a scuola, le angherie del suo prepotente capo alla sala giochi locale e il dover badare al fratello minore, alla sorella e alla madre maniaco-depressiva, la vita di Sarah Taylor non è facile. Mentre il suo amore per la commedia cresce e la vetrina si avvicina, il delicato equilibrio della sua vita diventa sempre più difficile da mantenere...

programme.title: Biuti Quin Olivia
programme.desc: Nei primi anni ottanta in una periferia di Roma cresce Olivia, una ragazza con un carattere difficile e ribelle rovinata da una situazione familiare difficile. La madre cameriera viene licenziata e il padre è un invalido civile violento e volgare. A scuola incontra una ragazza, Lili, con la quale litiga spesso. Quel che sembrava una rivalità ostile, diventerà invece una solida amicizia. Lili organizza a scuola un concorso chiamato appunto Biuti Quin Olivia alla quale partecipa volentieri anche Olivia.I genitori però non vogliono. Infine le due amiche cercheranno il vero padre di Olivia.

programme.title: Sing Street
programme.desc: Un ragazzo cresciuto a Dublino durante gli anni '80 evade dalla sua complicata situazione familiare, formando una band per far colpo sulla ragazza che gli piace.

programme.title: Rams
programme.desc: In una valle islandese isolata, Gummi e Kiddiley vivono fianco a fianco, badando al gregge di famiglia, considerato uno dei migliori del paese. I due fratelli vengono spesso premiati per le loro preziose pecore appartenenti a un ceppo antichissimo. Benché dividano la terra e conducano la stessa vita, Gummi e Kiddi non si parlano da quarant'anni. Quando una malattia letale colpisce il gregge di Kiddi, minacciando l'intera vallata, le autorità decidono di abbattere tutti gli animali della zona per contenere l'epidemia.

programme.title: Tutte Le Cose Che Non Sai Di Lui
programme.desc: Jennifer Garner è la star di Catch and Release della scrittrice-regista Susannah Grant. Dopo la morte improvvisa del fidanzato, Gray Wheeler (Garner) trova conforto nei suoi amici: lo spensierato Sam (Kevin Smith), il super responsabile Dennis (Sam Jaeger) e, abbastanza stranamente, il suo vecchio amico d'infanzia Fritz (Timothy Olyphant), un irresponsabile playboy.

programme.title: Fiori d'acciaio
programme.desc: Nella fittizia Chinquapin, Louisiana, si sta preparando un matrimonio. La sposa è Shelby (Julia Roberts) la cui madre (Sally Field), farebbe di tutto per lei.

programme.title: Julie & Julia
programme.desc: Una quasi trentenne frustrata da un impiego temporaneo come segretaria si sfida da sola ai fornelli: dovrà preparare tutte le 524 ricette del manuale di cucina di Julia Child in un anno. E racconta le sue tribolazioni in un blog che conquista gli amanti del cibo.

programme.title: I Puffi
programme.desc: Quando lo stregone cattivo Gargamella insegue i piccoli puffi blu fuori dal loro villaggio, dal loro mondo magico cadono nel nostro, trovandosi nel bel mezzo di Central Park a New York. I Puffi dovranno trovare il modo di ritornare al loro villaggio prima che Gargamella li catturi.

programme.title: Il ras del quartiere
programme.desc: Domingo, capo di teppisti e custodi del quartiere, aiuta un uomo a cercare la figlia scappata di casa

programme.title: Mi faccia causa
programme.desc: Davanti al pretore Giovanni Pennisi transita tutti i giorni un campionario di varia umanità,

programme.title: Scusi ma lei le paga le tasse
programme.desc: Un funzionario cade in disgrazia per colpa del nipote, che poi gli soffia la promozione.

programme.title: La governante
programme.desc: La nuova governante francese Caterina Leher sconvolge la famiglia Platania, portando caos e tragedie

programme.title: Anni difficili
programme.desc: Con Umberto Spadaro, Massimo Girotti e Ave Ninchi, Aldo Piscitello deve aderire al Partito Fascista e affrontare la guerra. Tra doveri familiari e scelte morali, cerca il coraggio di restare fedele a sé stesso in un'Italia in crisi.

programme.title: Vita da cani
programme.desc: Le vite di diversi personaggi si intrecciano in un susseguirsi di difficoltà quotidiane e situazioni comiche. Aldo Fabrizi, Gina Lollobrigida e Marcello Mastroianni sono protagonisti di una commedia che racconta le piccole disavventure della vita, con ironia e causticità.

programme.title: Il fischio al naso
programme.desc: Un uomo, interpretato da Ugo Tognazzi, si ritrova coinvolto in una serie di situazioni comiche e paradossali, tutto a causa di un fischio al naso che cambia inaspettatamente la sua vita. Una commedia surreale e ironica che esplora la follia delle circostanze.

programme.title: Totò Sexy
programme.desc: Due suonatori ambulanti finiscono in carcere per contrabbando e si rifugiano in sogni popolati da donne seducenti e atmosfere esotiche. Una commedia musicale guidata dall'ironia inconfondibile di Totò, tra gag surreali e fantasia.

programme.title: American Carnage
programme.desc: Una nuova legge permette l' arresto dei figli di immigrati irregolari. Per evitare il carcere i giovani hanno una sola opportunità: fare volontariato in una misteriosa casa di cura fornendo assistenza agli anziani.

programme.title: Crimen Perfecto
programme.desc: Rafael è un uomo distinto, fascinoso e donnaiolo. Di sposarsi non ne vuol sapere e si gode il successo come venditore di un grande magazzino dove è il re incontrastato del reparto femminile. Quando uccide involontariamente un suo collega dovrà vedersela con i ricattati di una misteriosa commessa.

programme.title: Io vivo altrove!
programme.desc: Un'improvvisa eredità spinge Fausto a proporre ad un amico di mollare tutto e trasferirsi nelle campagne del Friuli, praticando l'agricoltura e cercando l'indipendenza economica.

programme.title: 10 Years
programme.desc: Un gruppo di ex liceali organizza una rimpatriata a distanza di dieci anni dal diploma per scoprire che, nonostante il passare del tempo, molte cose sembrano essersi fermate ad allora.

programme.title: Restiamo Amici
programme.desc: Alessandro viene improvvisamente contattato, dal Brasile, dal suo vecchio amico Gigi. In punto di morte, l'uomo ha un ultimo favore: per ereditare i tre milioni di euro che gli ha lasciato suo padre deve intestarli a suo figlio. Ma Gigi non ha eredi.

programme.title: 10 Cose Da Fare Prima Di Lasciarsi
programme.desc: Ben e Abigail si conoscono a un appuntamento al buio in un bar e, per gioco, stilano una lista delle dieci cose da fare insieme prima di lasciarsi. Dopo aver passato la notte insieme, le cose prendono una piega inaspettata.

programme.title: Alaska
programme.desc: Un californiano insoddisfatto accoglie con gioia la notizia di un'eredità che lo attende in Alaska. Ma per impadronirsene deve purtroppo affrontare una prova molto dura.

programme.title: Lillo e Greg: The Movie
programme.desc: Una collezione antologica delle migliori scenette comiche firmate da Lillo e Greg, in compagnia di tanti famosi colleghi. Un concentrato di ironia e musica dai tratti surreali e farseschi.

programme.title: La miliardaria
programme.desc: Epifania ha ereditato da suo padre una fortuna favolosa e un consiglio sul tipo di uomo da sposare. Lei, invece, si sposa senza seguire il consiglio di suo padre, ma il matrimonio si rivela un fallimento.

programme.title: El Zorro
programme.desc: ra intrighi e ingiustizie, il misterioso Zorro combatte contro l'oppressione difendendo il popolo con astuzia e abilità, tra duelli e azioni spettacolari.

programme.title: Zorro contro Maciste
programme.desc: Tra duelli e imprese eroiche, Zorro e Maciste uniscono le forze contro un potere tirannico, tra azione e colpi di scena. Diretto da Umberto Lenzi

programme.title: L'assedio di Siracusa
programme.desc: Tra assedi, strategie e passioni, Siracusa resiste all'avanzata romana in una sfida che decide il destino della città. Con Sylva Koscina.

programme.title: Giulio Cesare
programme.desc: Abile politico, fine scrittore, valoroso soldato, ma anche semplice uomo. Tutta la vita di Giulio Cesare, dalle grandi gesta, all'amore per Cleopatra, fino al tragico assassinio. Diecimila comparse, seicento cavalli, fedeli ricostruzioni storiche: l'incredibile vita di uno degli uomini più importanti della storia. Con Jeremy Sisto, Richard Harris, Christopher Walken e Valeria Golino.

programme.title: Black Jack
programme.desc: In seguito alla rapina di una banca nel selvaggio West, una banda si riunisce intorno a Jack Murphy, il loro capo. Le cose vanno male quando Skinner, Reb, Mathias e i fratelli Bill e Gordon si rendono conto che Jack dividerà il bottino solo per il suo bene. Furiosi con lui, decidono di tradirlo e non passa molto tempo prima che entrino in azione.

programme.title: I lunghi giorni dell'odio
programme.desc: Nel Texas del 1870, Martin Benson, agente sotto copertura, aiuta l'esercito contro i contrabbandieri che armavano gli indigeni. Prima di ritirarsi, gli viene chiesto di smascherarne il capo. Accetta l'ultimo incarico, ma durante il viaggio scopre che la sua famiglia è stata brutalmente colpita dai banditi, spingendolo in una missione ancora più personale.

programme.desc: Un neonato sopravvissuto a un massacro viene adottato dagli indiani e cresce come fratello del figlio del capo. Un tragico incidente lo condanna all'esilio. In città subisce un'ingiustizia crudele, ma sopravvive e torna per affrontare il suo passato e il destino dell'“Apache bianco”.

Dopo l'uccisione della ragazza del saloon Dolores da parte di un suo uomo, Arizona accetta di dare la caccia all'assassino in cambio di denaro e dell'aiuto di Jane.

Tra cameo e celebri citazioni, l'avventura si fa sempre più avvincente.

programme.title: The Absent One

Un certo numero di indizi portano ad un gruppo di studenti di un collegio vicino ma il caso è chiuso quando un uomo si dichiara colpevole e viene condannato. Quando, 20 anni dopo, il caso finisce sulla scrivania di Carl Mørck, il detective si rende subito conto che c'è qualcosa di terribilmente sbagliato. Insieme ad Assad, collega e amico, Carl inizia ad indagare sul caso e, trovando una vecchia chiamata d'emergenza di una ragazza disperata, si rende conto che questa sembri sapere cosa sia accaduto. Così i due si mettono sulle tracce di Kimmie, che è scomparsa dal tempo degli omicidi. Ma Carl e Assad non sono gli unici che cercano di rintracciarla come testimone. In realtà la ragazza è in grande pericolo perché un gruppo di uomini influenti farà tutto il possibile per mantenere il suo silenzio….
